name: omnis-swarm
description: Swarm coordination for Claude Code: topology, shared memory and a task board, all recorded to an event log that a live, read-only pane draws.

panel.title: Swarm pane
panel.description: command (the default): the pane opens only with /omnis pane or /omnis-swarm:watch. auto: it also opens when a swarm starts. off: it never opens.

clashGuard.title: File clash guard
clashGuard.description: block (the default): an agent can't edit a file another live agent is editing. warn: the edit goes ahead and the lead is told. off: no check.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: auto (the default): treated as a subscription once Claude Code reports your 5-hour or 7-day usage window, else pay-as-you-go. subscription: no dollar limits, costs still shown, the time-box stays. api: pay-as-you-go, every limit applies.

budgetAgentMinutes.title: Agent time-box (minutes)
budgetAgentMinutes.description: An agent running this long is asked to wrap up; it is warned at two thirds of it. 1 to 1440.

budgetAgentUsd.title: Agent budget (USD, approximate)
budgetAgentUsd.description: An agent whose estimated spend reaches this is asked to wrap up; it is warned at three fifths. Above 0, at most 1000.

verifyGate.title: Verification gate
verifyGate.description: block (the default): a task can't be marked done while its build or tests fail. warn: it closes anyway and the reply carries the failure. off: no gate.

gateCommand.title: Gate command
gateCommand.description: The command the gate runs. Leave empty to have it found from the project (scripts/build-test, npm run check, npm test, dotnet test).

gateMinutes.title: Gate time limit (minutes)
gateMinutes.description: A gate running longer is stopped and counts as a failure. 1 to 60.

scopeFence.title: Scope fence
scopeFence.description: block (the default): an agent can only edit the files its task owns. warn: the edit goes ahead and the lead is told. off: no check.

modelHints.title: Model hints
modelHints.description: on (the default): swarm starts show which models past runs did well on, from this project and across projects. project: this project’s runs only, nothing kept outside it. off: no history kept, no hints.

budgetSwarmUsd.title: Swarm budget (USD)
budgetSwarmUsd.description: Past this, the lead can't start new agents until you raise it with /omnis budget <usd>; it warns at half. Above 0, at most 1000.
